plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: [ -z "$COCKPIT_PACKAGED_VERSION" ] || [ "${nextRelease.version}" = "$COCKPIT_PACKAGED_VERSION" ] || { echo "semantic-release decided ${nextRelease.version}, but the package job built $COCKPIT_PACKAGED_VERSION" >&2; exit 1; }

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>

## Install

Cockpit isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Once only:

1. Download the `.dmg` for your Mac below — `arm64` for Apple silicon, `x64` for Intel — and drag Cockpit into Applications.
2. Open Cockpit. When macOS says it can't verify the app, click **Done**.
3. In System Settings › Privacy & Security, click **Open Anyway** — or in Terminal: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cockpit.app`

After that, Cockpit updates itself.

[Full install guide](https://github.com/tashtit/cockpit#install) · Verify a download: `gh attestation verify <file> --owner tashtit`
